qa_pairs.question: What role does the Business Identification Number (BIN) play in the lifecycle of an Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) status according to the 2024 regulations?
qa_pairs.answer: The Business Identification Number (BIN) is a mandatory requirement for the renewal of an Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) status. According to the list of updated documents required for renewal, the applicant must provide an updated BIN [9].
